title: Evaluating Tibetan Speech Recognition Across Dialects and Adaptation Regimes: A Multi-Granularity Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.27002v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tibetan speech recognition is usually evaluated with character or syllable error rates because the writing system does not mark word boundaries. These metrics can rank systems differently and respond differently to adaptation failures. We combine character error rate, syllable error rate, and segmented word error rate in one evaluation framework. We use dictionary-based, neural, and language-model-based segmentation and compare their boundaries with expert annotations. We evaluate five ASR architectures on Lhasa Tibetan, then test zero-shot transfer and target-corpus adaptation on five additional corpus subsets. We also vary LoRA rank and training-data size to examine adaptation failure. The results show that a lower character error does not always lead to a lower syllable or segmented-word error. These ranking differences persist across corpora. Metric correlations also weaken in some unsuccessful adaptation settings. Higher LoRA ranks

translated_title: 跨方言与适应场景下的藏语语音识别评估：一种多粒度分析
translated_abstract: 由于藏文书写系统不标注词边界，藏语语音识别通常采用字符错误率或音节错误率进行评估。这些指标可能会对系统给出不同的排序，并且对适应失败的反应也不尽相同。我们将字符错误率、音节错误率和分词错误率整合到同一个评估框架中。我们使用基于词典的、神经网络的以及基于语言模型的分词方法，并将其切分边界与专家标注进行对比。我们在拉萨藏语上评估了五种ASR架构，然后在五个额外的语料库子集上测试零样本迁移和目标语料库适应。我们还通过改变LoRA秩和训练数据规模来考察适应失败的情况。结果表明，较低的字符错误并不总能带来较低的音节错误率或分词错误率。这种排序差异在各语料库中持续存在。在某些失败的适应设置中，各指标之间的相关性也会减弱。较高的LoRA秩……
tldr: 本文提出整合字符、音节和分词三种错误率的多粒度评估框架，对藏语语音识别在跨方言和LoRA适应场景下的表现进行系统评估，发现较低字符错误率并不必然意味着音节或分词层面的更好表现，且指标间相关性会在适应失败时减弱。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-granularity evaluation framework combining character, syllable, and segmented word error rates for Tibetan ASR across dialects and adaptation regimes, showing that lower character error does not always imply better syllable or word-level performance, and that metric correlations weaken in unsuccessful adaptation settings.
